column1: # Reviewed native macOS FFI boundary; this is separate from the historical baseline.
# Rust requires unsafe to declare/call the C ABI and to read its opaque context.
# Production clauses are reviewed beside their SAFETY comments in macos.rs:
# ABI declarations/signatures match path_monitor.h; Send/Sync require a unique
# owner and synchronous cancellation; start/stop preserve the boxed context;
# notify checks null and borrows only until the native cancellation barrier.
# Mock clauses mirror the same ABI: output pointers are caller-owned, each
# handle has one Box owner, and callbacks only borrow a live adapter context.
# Lifecycle tests cover failure/null handles, callbacks during cancellation,
# initial delivery, coalescing, receiver closure, repeated and cross-thread drop.
# Every token in both reviewed files is fingerprinted to detect body changes;
# comments/formatting are normalized. FNV-1a64 is a change detector, not crypto.
# Rows: count<TAB>exact file<TAB>unsafe<TAB>exact trimmed source line.
